regime: explicit Wright-Fisher symmetric island model, 200 demes, migration then reproduction with the census read post-migration (the recurrence's declared composition convention); identity-probability F_ST on DISTINCT pairs as a ratio of averages over loci; 10 independent replicate metapopulations per cell, sem across replicates. m is swept 50-fold at fixed 4*Ne*m by shrinking Ne, which is what separates the two closed forms; 4*Ne*m is swept 4-fold so the rival has a span. rel_floor 0.05 absorbs the O(1/d) finite-deme term.
